_about: Announcements from the hosts, shown newest first (notices with the same date keep the order below). Only entries with "published": true are built into the page. "body" may hold several paragraphs separated by a blank line; "closing" is the sign-off line, set in italics. "link" takes a label and a url (a section of the site such as #archives, or a full web address); add "opensRsvp": true for a link that opens the RSVP slip. "style" is "note" or "telegram". Before launch: if the site goes live on a different day, change these dates to the launch date, and if the RSVP date changes, update the wording of the first notice.

notices.title: An Invitation Has Arrived
notices.body: The guest register is officially open. Discover your assigned identity, begin preparing your finest attire and kindly reserve your place at The Velvet Cellar by 28th November.

notices.title: A Word of Caution…
notices.body: Every guest has a story, and every story has its secrets. Your personal dossier awaits in the Confidential Archives, but do resist the temptation to delve into anyone else’s affairs.
notices.closing: After all, curiosity can be a dangerous thing.
